executiveSummary: Final assembly is live this week and Ash is hands-on it today. The whole MVP timeline now hinges on the 5-unit sample build (Minewing) to QC to mass production around June 8. All paid components are in hand, the retail box is in mass production, and the wire harnesses arrived May 27.

The last pre-ship blocker is the EMC cert and now two labs are bidding: Anbotek (EN 50498 + FCC, $500, 6 working days) and Cer-Mark (Patty Guo), both replied with attachments and are unread. Pick one and pay to keep a clean June ship.

Sales are not dry. Order #1018 (Taiwan) landed May 28, just 4 days ago. Lifetime is 11 paid orders worth $1,591 (the prior $1,750 figure was pre-audit and overstated). The order came straight off the social funnel.

Traffic surged again (site visits 293, +68%) but conversion is thin at ~0.32%. The funnel is clean (0 rage clicks) so the leak is the close. EB15 (15% off, $144.50) is live, unannounced, and closes June 6, and the Brevo send budget resets today.

news.headline: SE Asia dry-season haze peaks now - Jakarta PM2.5 climbs through June-August
news.detail: Jakarta PM2.5 follows a seasonal pattern peaking June-August (dry season), with El Nino making it worse. Motorcyclists carry the highest black-carbon exposure of any commuter group - directly Easi Breezi's core use case.
news.opportunity: Time an AQI-spike ride-along reel (Bali / Jakarta in real smog) to the haze, with the 'motorcyclists breathe the most black carbon - you just can't see it' hook. Feeds both TikTok reach and the 'helmet vs air purifier' FAQ-page SEO gap.

landscape: Zyon's mid-2026 deliveries and tech-licensing plans keep validating the category, but at ~EUR720-799 they're a luxury whole-helmet play. Our wedge holds: modular, ~5-6x cheaper, fits any helmet, ships now, real HEPA H11. The bigger story today is execution: final assembly is live, the retail box is in mass production, and the only pre-ship blocker left is choosing an EMC test lab (Anbotek vs Cer-Mark vs NTEK). On demand, the constraint has flipped from traffic to conversion - visits are up 68% but CVR is ~0.32%. Priority order: pick and pay the EMC lab, keep the TikTok engine running, fire the EB15 blast now that credits reset, and convert organic search with an FAQ page. SE Asia haze season is a direct June tailwind.
